_comment: Findings somebody has looked at and decided to live with.
POST /acknowledgements writes this file and DELETE /acknowledgements/{id}
takes an entry back; it is also still editable by hand. Either way the
decision only reaches anybody else's checkout once somebody commits the
diff. An acknowledgement does not hide a finding: it keeps its level and
its place in the list, and is counted separately as well. The guards on
rule_id must match exactly. There are no wildcards, because one pattern
silencing a whole class of finding is how these go wrong.
An entry with no 'until' expires 180 days after 'on'. Past that the finding
returns at full volume and the stale entry is itself reported.

acknowledgements.reason: A personal CV site. Static website hosting is on with index.html as the index document, and the only objects are index.html and style.css. It is meant to be readable by anyone.
The four blocks have to be off for the public website policy above to take effect. Acknowledged together with it, and only for as long as it is.
